content.short: Recap is a privacy-first crypto tax app.
content.description: Recap is a privacy-first crypto tax tool that simplifies tax calculations. It delivers a privacy-focused, easy-to-use interface to help users compute taxes, even when thousands of transactions span multiple wallets, blockchains and exchanges. By consolidating activity from these sources, Recap helps you see a clear picture of your holdings and tax exposures while keeping your data private. Recap enables users to track their crypto portfolio, optimise their tax position, and automatically calculate their crypto taxes.
